title: How to Install a New Kitchen Faucet | Ask This Old House

locations.name: probable kitchen sink area
locations.basis: Transcript centers on installing a faucet at a kitchen sink; no explicit filming location is stated.

summary: This video walks through upgrading a four-hole kitchen sink setup to a modern single-hole faucet with a deck plate and a soap dispenser. It covers selecting a faucet with an integrated pull-down spray, choosing a deck plate to cover extra holes, and mounting the faucet with a gasket, plumber’s putty, and an underside washer. The guide also covers securing the faucet with screws, weight-adding for the pull-down spray hose, connecting hot and cold water with compression fittings, installing the soap dispenser, verifying new shutoffs, and testing water and soap output before wrapping up.

sections.title: Plan and select faucet hardware
sections.description: Discusses the existing sink with four holes, the choice of a single-hole faucet with an integrated pull-down spray, and the option to cover three holes with a deck plate while leaving one for a soap dispenser.

sections.title: Mounting order and gasket setup
sections.description: Outlines the mounting sequence (gasket, deck plate, putty, underside gasket, washer, and screws) and explains how tightening the assembly creates a leak-free seal.

sections.title: Seal base with plumber's putty
sections.description: Demonstrates applying plumber's putty to the base area under the gasket to prevent leaks between the plate and sink.

sections.title: Spray hose preparation and water connections
sections.description: Shows positioning and securing the spray hose (adding a weight to retract it) and connecting hot and cold water supplies with compression fittings.

sections.title: Soap dispenser and shutoffs
sections.description: Installs the soap dispenser in the remaining hole and confirms the new shutoffs under the sink are functioning.

sections.title: Test run and wrap-up
sections.description: Tests the faucet and soap dispenser in operation and closes with a channel call-to-action.
